name: carbon_a_annotate_cds
description: Annotate protein-coding genes in a eukaryotic DNA sequence with Carbon-A (HuggingFaceBio/Carbon-A-1.2B), a 1.2B-parameter DNA model that predicts coding sequence at single-base resolution on both strands, followed by its annotation pipeline: a transition network, a Viterbi decode over a gene grammar (start codon to in-frame stop, GT-AG/GC-AG/AT-AC introns, reading frame continued across introns), and a confidence network that scores each gene. Returns gene coordinates, strand, exon count, per-gene confidence and optionally the GFF3 and translated proteins. Give either an inline sequence of at least 100,000 bp or a FASTA file in the provider's input directory. Needs a provider with a CUDA GPU and runs at roughly 10 kbp per second. Use for: finding genes in a newly assembled eukaryotic genome, re-annotating a region, or scoring how confidently a locus codes for protein.

sequence.description: Genomic DNA to annotate, as bare IUPAC nucleotides with no FASTA header. Carbon-A reads 98,304 bp windows and the pipeline skips records shorter than min_record_length, so this must be at least 100,000 bp unless you lower that deliberately. Pass input_file instead for a whole genome.

sequence_id.description: Name for the inline record, used as the GFF seqid. Default 'query'.

input_file.description: FASTA or GenBank file name relative to the provider's Carbon-A input directory, for example 'yeast/GCF_000146045.2.fna', optionally gzip-compressed. Absolute paths, '..' segments and URLs are rejected.

genetic_code.description: Translation table used to close genes at an in-frame stop. 'standard' is the default; 'tetrahymena_table6' is NCBI table 6, which Tetrahymena thermophila (GCF_000189635.1) needs. A code that does not fit the sequence makes the pipeline flag the run, and that flag is returned in warnings.

min_confidence.description: Only return genes whose confidence reaches this. Confidence is the model's own probability that a gene's structure is exactly right. 0.1 is the threshold the model card reports its gene counts at. Genes the pipeline gave no confidence are always returned.

min_record_length.description: Records shorter than this are skipped by the pipeline rather than annotated. Its own floor is 100,000 bp, which is the default here; below that the model is outside its reported range.

attn_implementation.description: Attention kernel. flash_attention_2 produced every result the model card reports and needs the flash-attn package on the provider; sdpa needs no extra package and is not bit-identical. Omit to use the provider's configured default.

max_genes.description: Maximum gene records to return, in genome order. The counts reported alongside them cover every gene, not just the returned ones.

return_gff.description: Include the full prediction as GFF3 text.

return_proteins.description: Include each returned gene's translated protein sequence.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time for the call, including any wait for another annotation to finish on the provider. Carbon-A runs at roughly 10 kbp per second on one GPU.

dry_run.description: Validate the arguments, including that input_file exists on the provider, and return the command that would run without running Carbon-A.

command.description: Command a dry run would execute, with per-call paths elided.

sequence_length.description: Length of the inline sequence, when one was passed.

genes_predicted.description: Genes in the prediction, before the confidence filter.

genes_note.description: Present when fewer genes are returned than passed the filter.

coding_bases.description: Total length of predicted CDS features.

warnings.description: The pipeline's own warnings, notably a genetic code that may not fit the sequence.

gff.description: Full prediction in GFF3, when return_gff is true.

confidence.description: Probability that the gene's structure is exactly right; null when the pipeline reported none.

incomplete.description: True when the gene is truncated by a record edge.

protein.description: Translated protein, when return_proteins is true.
